connector.name: PromptGuard Scan MCP
connector.registryDescription: Paid remote MCP for LLM security scans, jailbreak checks, analytics, checkout, and readiness.
connector.summary: Hosted at promptguardscan.space over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace space.promptguardscan, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Bearer token issued after checkout and MCP token claim.
